name: Curify
about: A telemedicine platform: video visits, e-prescriptions, a patient app, a doctor panel and subscriptions.

personas.name: Matylda Jedynak
personas.role: Product owner of the video visits, a serial entrepreneur
personas.style: Startup words (MVP, scale, quick win, pivot). Mentions her other companies and fast decisions. Writes in a hurry, but the request is clear.

personas.name: Rafał Domański
personas.style: Developer slang, short lines, often no Polish letters. Uses words like 'ticket', 'fix', 'prod'.

personas.name: Liam Murphy
personas.style: Writes only in English. Short and friendly, 'cheers' at the end.

personas.name: Bogdan Kalinowski
personas.style: Lists points with dashes. Names the law, ZUS or P1 as the reason for the request.

personas.name: Ilona Szymańska
personas.style: Polite questions: 'czy mogłabyś', 'byłabym wdzięczna'. Explains why she needs the change.

personas.name: Hannah Becker
personas.role: Developer from Germany who learns Polish
personas.style: Polish with small grammar errors and wrong cases. Sometimes adds an English word in brackets.

personas.name: Patrycja Lewandowska
personas.role: Product manager of the patient app
personas.style: Enthusiastic marketing tone, exclamation marks and emoji. Talks about the users and the release.

personas.name: Szymon Krupa
personas.style: Lower case, abbreviations (pls, asap, imo, btw), no full stops.

personas.name: Julia Kowalczyk
personas.style: Describes what the user sees on the screen. Rarely knows issue keys.

personas.name: Halina Stępień
personas.style: Formal letter style ('Szanowni Państwo', 'z poważaniem'). Uses medical words and not Jira words.

personas.name: Konrad Sikorski
personas.role: Frontend developer of the doctor panel
personas.style: Very short commands in the imperative, no greetings.

personas.name: Ryan Walsh
personas.style: Polish sentences with many English words, informal ('hej', 'super').

personas.name: Magdalena Czerwińska
personas.role: Product owner of payments and subscriptions
personas.style: Business language with numbers and deadlines: the end of the month, invoices, revenue.

personas.name: Dawid Kozłowski
personas.style: Complains about old code and ironic remarks, but the request is exact.

personas.name: Agata Wilczek
personas.style: Not sure about IT words, apologizes and explains a lot. Writes full polite sentences.
